theorems.name: Submission.cbr_ci_cp_fp_tsum_weight_le_one
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (V : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (Z : Set (Euclid P)) (a : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞), Module.finrank ℝ V = n → Z ⊆ (Vᗮ : Set (Euclid P)) → ν = Measure.sum (fun w : Z => a w • (μHE[n]).restrict {y : Euclid P | y - w ∈ V}) → (∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → ν (ball 0 R) ≤ unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (R ^ n)) → ∑' w : Z, a w ≤ 1
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
